title: Transparent PNGs and hover reveal
summary: Transparent images now keep their alpha when Arras resizes or replaces them, and widgets can optionally stay hidden until the pointer moves over them.
details: Large transparent PNGs are downsampled without being flattened to JPEG.
Image replacement also preserves alpha instead of forcing transparent stills through JPEG.
Reveal on hover is a per-widget option that fades to the configured opacity without changing the saved opacity.
Behind Icons keeps widgets visible because macOS does not deliver pointer events at that depth.
